I couldn't confirm the switch to `just` from this checkout. On `main` (commit `75a6db5`), the `Makefile` is still there and there's no `justfile`, so the change is probably on another branch or hasn't been merged yet.

The fast tests are the unit tests, which skip anything marked `postgres`. The current `Makefile` runs them with:

```
pytest -m "not postgres" -q
```

You can run that command directly whether or not `make` or `just` is involved. If the new `justfile` copies the old targets, the equivalent is probably `just test-fast`, but I haven't seen the file so I can't confirm the recipe name. Run `just --list` on the branch that has it to check.

The full suite (`pytest -q`) also runs the Postgres tests, so you need `docker compose up db` running first.

I haven't updated the project's saved note in EngramDB yet. It still says to use `make test-fast` and `make test`, and since the repo here still matches it, changing it now would make it wrong. Once the `justfile` is on `main`, or if you tell me the recipe names, I can update it.
